universal_patterns.pattern: any holder of a license[^.]*under this title

proposal.rationale: The undetermined sections in Chapter 1 are administrative provisions about county sheriffs, clerks, treasurers furnishing licenses, collecting fees, fines, and penalties. They do not contain universal applicability language and do not enumerate practice acts — they apply generally to county-level license administration but the text itself uses generic language like "any person subject to such license" or "this act" without identifying a list of professions/chapters. There is no reliable regex signal to mark these as title- or chapter-wide universal, so leaving them undetermined for triage is the correct conservative choice. Patterns unchanged.
